reader.requirement: After RELEASE ... FROM identifier-1 completes, identifier-1's area still holds what it held (the implicit MOVE reads it and nothing writes it), for every identifier-1 class 85 admits: group, elementary numeric, reference-modified, variable-length (ODO) group and, under Amendment 1, an alphanumeric function-identifier.

edition-consulted.switches: rangeFailsStatement = DialectLevel < 2002: at 85 a varying record outside the record range makes the RELEASE unsuccessful (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10); later editions release it. The 'also available' store is gated on that success

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition/DialectLevel/DialectBehavior in SortBinder.BindRelease and SortEmitter.EmitRelease; the FROM literal-1 arm is gated post-1985 in VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitRecordFromPhrase (a refusal of a different rule); the FROM phrase is bound as the one implicit MOVE (MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase) at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_release_from_sender_available covers a group identifier; not exercised: elementary numeric, reference-modified, ODO and function-identifier senders

reader.notes: EmitRelease emits the bound FROM MOVE (record-name-1 is its only receiver) and then the release of the record image; nothing on the path writes identifier-1. SR3 keeps identifier-1 off the record's own storage.
